Subject: SI-MP-0005 Precision coolant bracket (SUP-05) — supporting evidence requested

Hello,

Thank you for the qualification packet for SI-MP-0005 rev A. Please send supporting evidence for the following items:

1. 1.internal_audit — internal audit program: procedure, schedule and recent audit records.
2. 1.capa — documented corrective-action (CAPA) process and sample records.
3. 1.calibration — gauge calibration program covering production gauges, with calibration records.
4. 2.pfmea — current process failure-mode analysis (PFMEA) for this part.
5. 2.control_plan — production control plan showing it covers Datum bore, Base thickness and Hole pitch.
6. 2.spc — SPC in use on the CTQs now: control charts and reaction plan.
7. 3.inspection_method — inspection methods and equipment used for the CTQ tolerances.
8. 5.lot_trace — lot traceability to raw material: procedure and an example trace record.
9. 5.nc_segregation — nonconforming material identification and segregation procedure and records.
10. 8.flowdown — evidence that requirements are flowed down to the sub-tier supplier.

Stark Industries Supplier Quality — Pepper Potts

audit_plan.question: quality_manual.md §1.1 claims an internal audit program with no records. Ask for the audit schedule, the latest audit reports and closure evidence for findings.
quality_manual.md §1.2 claims a corrective-action program with no records. Review the CAPA procedure and sample closed CAPAs, including root cause and effectiveness checks.
quality_manual.md §9.1 claims a gauge calibration program with no records. Verify calibration status and intervals of the gauges used for the datum bore, base thickness and hole pitch CTQs.
